verse.verse_2: How tremendous is the true event!
verse.verse_3: And what have you understood, how tremendous the true event is!
verse.verse_4: The tribes of Thamud and A’ad denied the event of great dismay. (The Day of Resurrection)
verse.verse_5: So regarding the Thamud, they were destroyed by a terrible scream.
verse.verse_6: And as for A’ad, they were destroyed by a severe thundering windstorm.
verse.verse_7: He forced it upon them with strength, consecutively for seven nights and eight days – so you would see those people overthrown in it, like trunks of date palms fallen down.
verse.verse_8: So do you see any survivor among them?
verse.verse_9: And Firaun, and those before him, and the dwellings that were inverted and thrown, had brought error.
verse.verse_10: They therefore disobeyed the Noble Messengers of their Lord – so He seized them with an intense seizure.
verse.verse_11: Indeed when the water swelled up, We boarded you onto the ship.
verse.verse_12: In order to make it a remembrance for you, and in order that the ears that store may remember.
verse.verse_13: So when the Trumpet will be blown, with a sudden single blow.
verse.verse_14: And the earth and the mountains will be lifted up and crushed with a single crush.
verse.verse_15: So that is the day when the forthcoming event will occur.
verse.verse_16: And the heaven will split asunder – so on that day it will be unstable.
verse.verse_17: And the angels will be on its sides; and on that day, eight angels will carry the Throne of your Lord above them.
verse.verse_18: On that day all of you will be brought forth, so none among you wishing to hide will be able to hide.
verse.verse_19: So whoever is given his book in his right hand – he will say, “Take, read my account!”
verse.verse_20: “I was certain that I will confront my account.”
verse.verse_21: He is therefore in the desired serenity.
verse.verse_23: The fruit clusters of which are hanging down.
verse.verse_24: “Eat and drink with pleasure – the reward of what you sent ahead, in the past days.”
verse.verse_25: And whoever is given his book in his left hand – he will say, “Alas, if only my account were not given to me!”
verse.verse_26: “And had never come to know my account!”
verse.verse_27: “Alas, if only it had been just death.”
verse.verse_28: “My wealth did not in the least benefit me.”
verse.verse_30: It will be said, “Seize him, and shackle him.”
verse.verse_31: “Then hurl him into the blazing fire.”
verse.verse_32: “Then bind him inside a chain which is seventy arm-lengths.”
verse.verse_33: “Indeed he refused to accept faith in Allah, the Greatest.”
verse.verse_34: “And did not urge to feed the needy.”
verse.verse_35: “So he does not have any friend here this day.”
verse.verse_36: “Nor any food except the pus discharged from the people of hell.”
verse.verse_37: “Which none except the guilty shall eat.”
verse.verse_38: So by oath of the things you see.
verse.verse_39: And by oath of those you do not see.
verse.verse_40: This Qur’an is the speech of Allah with a gracious Noble Messenger.
verse.verse_41: And it is not the speech of a poet; how little do you believe!
verse.verse_42: Nor is it the speech of a soothsayer; how little do you ponder!
verse.verse_43: Sent down by the Lord Of The Creation.
verse.verse_44: And had he fabricated just one matter upon Us –
verse.verse_45: We would have definitely taken revenge from him.
verse.verse_46: Then would have cut off his heart’s artery.
verse.verse_47: Then none among you would be his saviour.
verse.verse_48: And indeed this Qur’an is an advice for the pious.
verse.verse_49: And indeed We know that some among you are deniers.
verse.verse_50: And indeed it is a despair for the disbelievers.
verse.verse_51: And indeed it is a certain Truth.
verse.verse_52: Therefore (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him), proclaim the purity of your Lord, the Greatest.
